summary: One administrator can now offboard most admins directly, with a second approval kept for the most sensitive accounts.

new.title: One administrator can offboard an admin
new.text: You can now delete, remove, disable or offboard an admin directly. A second administrator approves only for tier 0 admins, break-glass accounts, or when the Pro second approver is on.

fixes.title: Every offboarding step is audited
fixes.text: Deleting is always done by a person, never automatically, and every such action is in the audit trail.

fixes.title: All levels L0-L9 are counted
fixes.text: Home and the per-level count now include levels L6-L9. An L7 group was counted as L1 before.
